content: Correction: Standard lead time for galvanized structural bolts from the primary FS supplier is 3 weeks, not 10 days. The 10-day figure only applies to stock A325 bolts already in the Phoenix warehouse.
title: FS galvanized bolt lead time correction

content: Fastening Specialists sells exclusively to resellers, never direct to end contractors. Net-30 terms are the default for resellers with an approved credit application on file.
title: FS reseller-only channel + Net-30 terms
